                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/developer-tianyiyun/p/19253943" title="发布于 2025-11-21 17:38">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一次编译器优化的陷阱</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文分享自天翼云开发者社区《<a href="https://www.ctyun.cn/developer/article/462372091191365" rel="noopener nofollow">一次编译器优化的陷阱</a>》.作者：江****禄</p>
<p>某次问题排查，最终隐掉完所有业务逻辑后， 化简为如下的简单代码：</p>
<div>来看一下，这个的bcount is zero 会打印吗？</div>
<pre class="language-c"><code class="language-c"><span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;time.h&gt;
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;stdio.h&gt;
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;stdlib.h&gt;
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;cstring&gt;
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;string.h&gt;
<span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;unistd.h&gt;

<span class="token keyword">int
<span class="token function">main<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token keyword">void<span class="token punctuation">)
<span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token keyword">int bcount <span class="token operator">= <span class="token number">2<span class="token punctuation">;

  <span class="token keyword">while <span class="token punctuation">(bcount <span class="token operator">&lt; <span class="token number">1296005092<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
     <span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">(bcount <span class="token operator">&lt; <span class="token number">1296005092<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
       <span class="token function">printf<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"b %lld (%d)%x is &lt;  than %lld\n"<span class="token punctuation">,bcount<span class="token punctuation">,bcount<span class="token punctuation">, bcount<span class="token punctuation">,<span class="token number">1296005092<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
     <span class="token punctuation">} <span class="token keyword">else <span class="token punctuation">{
       <span class="token function">printf<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"b %lld (%d)%x is &gt;= than %lld\n"<span class="token punctuation">,bcount<span class="token punctuation">,bcount<span class="token punctuation">,bcount<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token number">1296005092<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
     <span class="token punctuation">}
     <span class="token function">sleep<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token number">1<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

     <span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">(bcount <span class="token operator">== <span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
      <span class="token function">printf<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"bcount is zero\r\n"<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
       <span class="token keyword">return <span class="token operator">-<span class="token number">1<span class="token punctuation">;
     <span class="token punctuation">}
     bcount <span class="token operator">*= <span class="token number">2<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">}

  <span class="token keyword">return <span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>这个demo代码的逻辑为：</p>
<p>while循环中比较bcount与1296005092的大小，当bcount &gt;=1296005092或者 bcount为0，结束循环。</p>
<p>使用gcc &nbsp;-O2优化编译后，查看demo程序的输出如下，可以看到，会导致一直在while死循环， 原因是bcount为int 。 然后待比较的那个数 刚好卡</p>
<p>在一个区间，具体如下：当bcount ==0x80000000时候，bcount最高位为1， 这样该数为负数，小于待比较的数1296005092，注意：</p>
<p>上一次循环中，由于上一个值0x40000000的时候刚好比1296005092小，然后此次循环结果为负数，而下一个循环这个int溢出结果为0 ，所以一直</p>
<p>卡在这里。那么问题就变成了：其中的bcount==0 不会生效？？</p>
<p><img width="694" height="799" data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/1c4f21c5690e4d39b1d6fac7017ac443.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>使用-O1编译后，查看demo代码的输出如下， 可以看到while循环中可以判断到bcount为0.</p>
<p><img width="703" height="704" data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/1953d217af2a4af3855592c64355dd2a.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>结论</h2>
<p>简化代码，对比两者汇编代码的区别如下,</p>
<p>可以看到在gcc的O2优化等级上，如果是乘2运算，优化后的代码认为结果不应该为0。</p>
<p>到此为止，这里如果将代码中的bcount乘2运算，替换为左移一位，在O2模式下编译，while循环也可以正常退出。</p>
<p>这里应该是gcc的O2等级以上优化逻辑有bug，在整数乘法运算下，编译器认为不可能出现结果为0，将代码中与0的判断优化掉，导致优化后的代码</p>
<p>逻辑不符合预期。</p>
<p><img width="698" height="441" data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/53e98096e3d748db82a6671416824124.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</div>
